# How to Limit Online Adaptation of Humanoid Real Machines to a Safer, Low-Dimensional Search Space?

> **Current answer:** The candidate scheme for Robot-Trains-Robot involves domain randomization in simulation to learn physics latent variables, freezing most of the strategy upon real machine deployment, and optimizing only one latent variable; while the force-sensing teacher arm is responsible for protection, curriculum, perturbation, failure detection, and reset.

## Problem and symptoms

- Online adaptation to real machines requires significant human protection, and exploration risks are high.
- Learning is weak or risky when the teacher arm is fixed or not scheduled.

## Environment

- Simulation pre-training; force-sensing teacher arm; walking and swing-up.

## Priority diagnostics

- Comparing compliant scheduling, fixed-arm baseline, and different assistance/perturbation phases.

## Possible causes

- Dynamics bias and difficulty jump in real machines cause unstable online exploration.

## Attempts

- Teacher arm follows, gradually reduces, synchronized treadmill, shaping reward, and automatic reset.

## Effective fixes

- Only optimize one physics latent variable, and the teacher arm schedules and protects.
